# cairn setup claude-code remove

Remove the Cairn MCP server from Claude Code config

## Help

```text
Remove the Cairn MCP server from Claude Code config

Usage: cairn setup claude-code remove [OPTIONS]

Options:
      --scope <SCOPE>
          Claude Code config scope: local or project

          Possible values:
          - local:   Register in the user's `~/.claude.json` for one project path
          - project: Register in the project's `.mcp.json`

          [default: local]

      --vault <NAME_OR_PATH>
          Active vault: name from registry or filesystem path (overrides CAIRN_VAULT)

      --project-dir <PATH>
          Project directory used for local/project Claude Code config

      --home-dir <PATH>
          Home directory used for local Claude Code config

      --server-name <NAME>
          Claude Code MCP server name to configure

          [default: cairn]

      --json
          Emit JSON receipt instead of human-readable output

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```
